recognize_zh: CD8 在下方正常紅髓的脾竇內襯細胞（littoral cells）呈強膜狀陽性，但上方病灶的吻合血管腔內襯細胞不著色、只見散在 CD8 陽性小淋巴球；病灶內襯細胞失去 CD8 表現是認出 littoral cell angioma 的線索。
features: Sharp contrast between CD8-positive native splenic sinus lining cells (lower field) and the lesion (upper field)
Normal red pulp sinusoids outlined by strong membranous CD8 staining in a ring-like, anastomosing pattern
Lesional vascular channels lack CD8 staining of their lining cells
Scattered CD8-positive small lymphocytes within the lesion
Lesion shows pale, loosely arranged channels with focal hemorrhage and fibrous areas
describe_en: Low-power CD8 immunostain of spleen shows a well-demarcated vascular lesion adjacent to uninvolved red pulp. The native splenic sinusoids in the adjacent red pulp are outlined by strong CD8 staining of the littoral lining cells, whereas the anastomosing channels of the lesion are negative, with only scattered CD8-positive T cells present. Loss of CD8 in the lesional lining cells, which otherwise have a littoral (endothelial-histiocytic) phenotype, supports littoral cell angioma.

ddx.vs: Native sinus littoral cells are CD8-positive throughout, whereas the lining cells of littoral cell angioma are characteristically CD8-negative.
Hemangioma channels are lined by flat endothelial cells lacking histiocytic markers (CD68, CD163) and CD21, while littoral cell angioma coexpresses endothelial and histiocytic markers.
SANT forms multiple angiomatoid nodules in a fibrous stroma containing CD34+/CD31+ capillaries, CD8+/CD31+ sinusoids and CD31+ small veins, rather than a single CD8-negative littoral phenotype.
Angiosarcoma shows solid areas, marked atypia, mitoses and infiltrative growth, which are not seen in this lesion.
